newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Ibex-35 blue chip index ends at new high.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Ibex-35 blue chip index ends at new high.

text.p: Spain's Ibex-35 blue chip index rose 2.33 percent, or 149.92 points, to another fresh closing high of 6,582.23 on Monday.
The broader general index also ended at a new high, adding 2.12 percent to 570.73.

This latest in a record-breaking series was supported in particular by strength in the banking sector. But in general dealers say shares are in free rise as investors seek more profitable alternatives to traditional savings instruments, with interest rates having fallen to historic lows.
